card.name: First word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word right after a numbered section heading in a drug label, such as Overdosage or Dosage and Administration subheadings. It also fires on a word inside a URL path.

modes.label: After overdosage subheading
modes.description: The word In starting the text under an Overdosage subsection heading.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Human Experience<< In>> premarketing trials involving more than 5

modes.label: After dosage heading
modes.description: The first word of a subheading under Dosage and Administration, such as Preparation or Regimen.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION<< Preparation>> and Administration ( 2.2 )

modes.label: Inside a web address
modes.description: A word piece in a URL path before a slash.

card.writes: It promotes line-break and comma-newline tokens, suggesting a pull toward punctuation that ends a line or item.
card.plain: It marks the opening word of a label subsection right after a numbered heading.
